title: Settling Premium Arrears on a Ridgecrest RxSecure Account by Telephone
content:
A member of a Ridgecrest RxSecure stand-alone Medicare Part D prescription drug plan who asks to bring their premium account up to date is quoted one figure and settles it on the call. The figure governs what the member is asked for and what is taken from them.

The amount the member is asked to settle is fixed only after every coverage month whose penalty the record no longer owes carries its removal entry on the premium account. Until each such coverage month carries that entry, the figure the member is asked for is not yet fixed.

The money the member settles is applied to the oldest coverage month for which the account still shows a premium component unsettled; a coverage month whose basic and supplemental premium components are both settled is not reopened by a late enrollment penalty still standing against it, because premium and penalty are relieved by different events and either may be owed without the other.

A settlement taken over the telephone is identified by the payment reference the plan issues at the moment the money is taken, so no settlement can repeat a reference already standing on the account.

## Taking the settlement

The settlement is taken with `authorize_arrears_payment_7dfec3b3`. The agent unlocks it and hands it over for the customer themselves to run, so that the member authorises the telephone payment from their own funds for the figure they have been quoted. The money is taken on the spot and posted to the account as a premium payment applied to the coverage month named, the member's premium receivable falls by the amount paid, and the member hears the plan's own payment reference for their records.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Form |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pdp_enrollment_id` | the reference number of the stand-alone Part D drug plan enrollment the money is paid onto, read from the member's enrollment record | an identifier |
| `customer_id` | the member reference number of the person authorising the payment, read from their member profile | an identifier |
| `billing_period` | the coverage month the money is applied to, in the plan's own billing calendar | written as YYYY-MM; never left empty |
| `payment_amount` | the sum the member authorises | in USD as a positive figure rounded to 2 decimal places, half-up at the point of posting; never left empty and never negative |

### Return

A confirmation sentence in plain text carrying the new premium payment entry's reference number, which doubles as the plan's payment reference for the member's own records, the drug plan enrollment reference number the money was posted on, the coverage month it was applied to, and the amount in USD taken. A sentence of this shape means the money has been taken and posted; any other text means no money was taken.
